observations: A head fills most of the frame against a flat amber-yellow ground; the face is built from overlapping color patches in olive, brown, rust and pale blue, with black outline strokes running across them.
A set of red concentric rings spirals outward from the right eye socket, growing looser toward the cheek and nose bridge, drawing attention to that area before any other feature.
The mouth is open, showing a row of white teeth; red lines define the lips, and loose red and black scribble marks extend down into the collar and chest area below the chin.
reading: The amber field holds the head steady while everything on its surface pulls in different directions. Olive and rust patches sit under black outlines that do not follow them, creating a layered restlessness. The red spiral at the eye reads as pressure or fixation rather than decoration. Bared teeth and the open mouth suggest something between a grin and a grimace — the image holds both without resolving them.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #266 and nnxyz nnotb #268. The amber ground links it visually to nnxyz rawblocks #42 — the collector connects both to scrimshaw through shared line-over-color patterning, which is the collector's reading, not a stated intent.

connections.reason: Both works place a face-like form on a saturated amber-yellow ground, with black and red line work running over colored underlayers — a direct visual parallel across two different owned series.

lookingQuestion: Where does the red spiral at the eye lead your gaze next, and what does it pass over before it stops?
ambiguities: The small dark shape at the nose bridge reads as either a separate object or a compressed feature — the image does not resolve this clearly.

nnxyz nnotb #266 (teal figure on dark ground) and nnxyz nnotb #268 (dark form on purple ground) share no strong formal parallel with #267 beyond series membership; only the rawblocks #42 connection is retained.

imageReview.method: Original PNG supplied to separate multimodal drafting and review calls
reviewFindings: Color and form checks confirmed against image: amber ground, olive/rust/pale-blue patches, black outlines, red concentric spiral at right eye, white teeth, red lip lines, and collar scribbles all verified present.
nnxyz nnotb #266 inspected: teal line figure on dark grey ground — no amber, no spiral eye, no color underlayers; correctly excluded from connections.

nnxyz nnotb #268 inspected: dark rounded form on purple ground with radiating marks — no face-like layered color or amber field; correctly excluded. rawblocks #42 connection confirmed: amber ground and face-like form with red and black line work over color fill visible in both images.
